name: the opt-in gate never stops the script
why: springsteenlyrics.com support is opt-in (sa_enable_springsteenlyrics, default off). Without the gate a published MusicBrainz script would rewrite another site's page for every user who has it installed.

name: no <h1> is injected for the toolbar
why: The SL list pages have no <h1>/<h2>; without the injected anchor init stops at its required-elements check and no button is offered at all.

name: fetched pages are not converted
why: Page 1 is the live document, converted at click time; page 2 arrives as raw cards. Skipping the conversion there drops every fetched page's rows, and the row count is what notices.

name: Load from Disk does not convert the fresh page's cards
why: After a reload the live page holds cards again. Without the disk-path conversion the headers block fabricates a bare table shell at the end of <body>, outside the site's content block.
grep: a reopened list renders in place

name: the navigation guard compares the path only
why: Every SL page is one PHP script told apart by its query string, so a path-only comparison calls collection.php?item=… the same page as the list and lets an item link discard the loaded table without asking.
grep: following an item link from the table asks first

name: Duration is not declared a ':'-aligned integer column
why: The integerColumns align ':' entry is what makes _sortColumnKind() sort Duration as a duration. As text, the 73-minute "1:13:36" sorts before "31:09.55" and the unknown "?:??" is not pinned last.

name: the site's "–" duration is kept verbatim
why: The ':'-aligned column split-aligns every cell, and a colon-less "–" renders as ":–". The converter writes MusicBrainz's "?:??" placeholder instead.
grep: card fields and flags are parsed

name: a card without a copies line is not counted as one copy
why: "I have N copies" only appears for N >= 2; the site's own "Nb. of copies = 1" filter shows that no line means one copy. A blank cell would also sort and filter apart from the 1s.
grep: card fields are parsed into their own columns

name: the trailing-parenthesis split takes the FIRST group
why: "Label (Cat #)" and "Release date (Original year)" end in one parenthesised group, but a label may carry its own parentheses; only the LAST group is the catalogue number or year.

name: First date ignores a day range
why: "16-17 Sep 1967" must start on the 16th; without the range group the regex anchors on "17 Sep".

name: the detection loop ignores the host
why: Recorded honestly as a guard no spec can see today: no MusicBrainz matcher claims /collection.php or /bootlegs.php, and no MusicBrainz URL reaches the SL matchers, so detection gives the same answer without it. It exists for the NEXT broad MusicBrainz matcher (several are bare path.includes() checks).

name: cards are looked up inside .project-detail only
why: On every collection page with the year-filter block (all categories but Official Albums, and the entry page) the site's stray closes .project-detail before the list, so a scoped lookup finds no card and the button converts nothing (2026-10-05).
grep: the single widget-less page becomes a table

name: the list heading is looked up inside .project-detail only
why:
Same stray : a .project-detail-scoped heading lookup finds nothing, so the toolbar

reads just "Collection" and the heading never becomes the h2 that carries the count and filter bar.

name: the fetch loop ignores pageParam
why: The collection entry page ignores page=N and answers page 1 again; only pg=N reaches page 2. With page= the table has 100 rows but only 50 distinct items.
grep: both pg= pages become one table

name: the page count ignores pageParam
why: The entry page's pagination links carry pg=, never page=, so reading page= finds no number and the count stays 1: only the live page is shown.
grep: both pg= pages become one table

name: the current page number ignores pageParam
why: Opened on ?pg=2, reading page= calls it page 1: the live page-2 cards stand in for page 1 and page 2 is fetched again.

name: the list heading h2 does not get its own class
why: The heading usually sits outside .project-detail (see _slFindCards()), so the h2 styling rule keys on mb-sl-list-heading, not on its position.
grep: the single widget-less page becomes a table

name: the entry page @include line is missing
why: Tampermonkey would never inject the script on collection.php; the fixture harness injects unconditionally, so only the regex spec can see it.

name: Sticky Page Headers stands down on springsteenlyrics.com again
why: Until 2026-10-05 initStickyPageHeaders() returned on SL, and everything above the table (breadcrumb, toolbar h1, category/filter blocks, list h2) scrolled away with a wide table.
grep: everything above the table stays put

name: sl-bootlegs has no stickyColumn
why: applyStickyColumn() then falls back to column 0, the Cover thumbnail, instead of Title.

name: sl-collection has no stickyColumn
why: Same fallback to the Cover column on every collection category list.

name: Sticky Page Headers does not descend into a full-width float
why:
On memorabilia/book a second stray closes the floated .col-sm-12 around .project-detail; _sphIsEligible() never pins a float, so pushed as a body the toolbar

and the category buttons scroll away (found by the live check, 2026-10-05).

name: the inner Bootstrap containers keep their auto margins
why: Centred in the table-wide column the year-filter block sat off-screen, and pinned, each width cap grew its auto margins and pushed it further right (left 1198 px, 120 px wide, live on book). Only the memorabilia/book shape pins that block on its own; on sampler it rides inside a pinned .project-detail capped to its own width, where the auto margins come out 0 anyway.

name: bootleg First date is not fed to dateParts
why: sl-bootlegs splits its ISO First date with the MusicBrainz dateParts extractor; an unknown extractor name leaves DD/MM/YYYY/Day/Month empty on every row.

name: bootleg Location is not split
why: Without a resolvable source column the four Place/Locality/Region/Country columns are never appended.

name: a US state leaves Country empty
why: The site never writes a country after a US state; without filling it in, a Country filter misses every US show.

name: several locations stay one
why: A multi-show bootleg's " - "-joined locations must become one <li> per location in every output column, aligned.

name: Place keeps only the first part
why: A venue name with a comma in it ("Studio A, The Power Station") is everything before the city, comma-joined.

name: a one-part description becomes a Country
why: "Various Location" / "Studio / Live" (brucelegs) are descriptions; taking the last part as Country would fill the Country column with them.

name: USA is kept as written
why: One country, one Country value: "USA" must read as United States, which a bare state already fills in.

name: the bootleg Show column stays empty
why: "27 Nov 1970 (early show)" must put "early show" in Show.

name: brucelegs Label and Cat # swapped
why: The two are separate card lines here (not "Label (Cat #)" as on the collection); each must reach its own column.

name: pageKeys: the live page is matched by number, not key

name: pageKeys: a page is fetched from the current URL, not its own link
why: The landing page lyrics.php has no cmd=list; only the letter link itself names the list. Fetching the current URL loads the landing page again, with no song lines.
